sections.shortTitle: Pakistan Civil Aviation Authority Amendment Ordinance 1984
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XIV OF 1984
ORDINANCE XIV OF 1984
PAKISTAN CIVIL AVIATION AUTHORITY (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1984
An Ordinance
further to amend the Pakistan Civil Aviation Authority Ordinance, 1982
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 15th April, 1984]
No. F. 17(1)/84-Pub.-The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information :-
1. Short title and commencement.-- This Ordinance may be called the
Pakistan Civil Aviation Authority (Amendment) Ordinance, 1984.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.description:
Amendment of section 16, Ordinance XXX of 1982

ORDINANCE XIV OF 1984
ORDINANCE XIV OF 1984
PAKISTAN CIVIL AVIATION AUTHORITY (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1984
An Ordinance
further to amend the Pakistan Civil Aviation Authority Ordinance, 1982
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 15th April, 1984]
No. F. 17(1)/84-Pub.-The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information :-
2. Amendment of section 16,
Ordinance XXX of 1982.-In the Pakistan Civil Aviation Authority Ordinance
1982 (XXX of 1982), in section 16, for the words "banks discharging
treasury functions on behalf of the Federal Government" the words,
bracket, comma and figures "any of the banks nationalized under the Banks
(Nationalization) Act, 1974 (XIX of 1974)" shall be substituted.
